meta.title: Mode switch
meta.description: Adds the composer's missing Plan button as the off-state half of the built-in Plan chip. While plan mode is off, a neutral Plan pill appears next to the permissions pill; clicking it enters plan mode, where the agent explores and proposes a plan before changing files, and the tinted Plan chip replaces it in the same spot. The pill uses the chip's own label and artwork in every shipped locale, so the two read as one toggle. The button drives the built-in plan state and /plan command. Plan mode is guidance, not an enforced read-only sandbox.
